references.text: Moses gave the command to build an altar on Mount Ebal after the Israelites had crossed the Jordan. Joshua carries out this command here.
Moses instructed that blessings and curses should be pronounced on Gerizim and Mount Ebal, which is the context for Joshua's building of the altar.
Earlier prophecy that the curse should be pronounced on Mount Ebal, where Joshua now builds the altar.
God's original command regarding how altars should be built, which Joshua followed on Mount Ebal.
The continuation of the account describing how the altar was built in accordance with Moses' law.
Elijah also builds an altar to the Lord, the God of Israel, as a parallel to Joshua's action.
